name: Swiftmend
description: [S03 - Tuning and Overrides Passive - Druid: Instantly heals a target with an active Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect for / Consumes a Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect on a friendly target to instantly heal them] an amount equal to 12 sec. of Rejuvenation or 18 sec. of Regrowth.
